scope: Parser acceptance, mode/prompt and rendered configuration delta only. No packet/protocol/GUI behavior or native IOS/Windows output equivalence is inferred.
method: Each old executable mode/path receives one or more fresh isolated current IOSSession probes using exact saved command/setup candidates. Historical old VM outcomes are attached as historical, not freshly verified or source-hash-revalidated. No reference implementation is copied or bundled. Rejection classification retains the existing audit helper and additionally identifies explicit Windows-profile syntax/unsupported errors; raw output and setup failures remain available. Neither is a substitute for native reference behavior.

reference.reason: Workspace reference copy is absent; macOS denies read access to the original /Volumes/Untitled/network-sandbox and the Trash copy. The old VM could not be rerun in this phase.

caveats: Positive mode/path registrations are deduplicated across old model variants; this is not all arguments on every model.
No previous current probe was reused because prior artifacts do not bind current runtime source hashes.
Current-only seeded commands are actual parser attempts; prerequisites rejected by the current profile remain failures and are not bypassed.
Intentional Windows host, PoE, VTP and other profile differences are observations, not automatic regressions or parity approvals.
A handler that returns an informational or stored-setting notice may be accepted by the legacy regex. Exact output, prompt and state hashes are retained for review.
Rendered configuration deltas do not cover runtime-only state, forwarding or protocol behavior.
Absence of a configured state change does not prove a command has no effect; interactive prompts and operational commands require separate behavior evidence.
